extra_vocab.en: to officially suggest someone for a job, prize, or promotion
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 managers may nominate up to two employees 指主管可以正式推薦最多兩位員工參加升遷審核，是人資公告中的正式用字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: nominate someone for 後面接獎項或職位，nominate someone as 後面接身分或職稱。

example.en: Each manager nominates one employee for the annual training program.
example.zh: 每位主管提名一名員工參加年度訓練計畫。

example.en: Three staff members were nominated for the innovation award.
example.zh: 有三位員工被提名角逐創新獎。

example.en: Nominating the right person takes careful thought and honest feedback.
example.zh: 提名對的人需要仔細思考和誠實的意見。

example.en: The team nominated Paul for the customer service award.
example.zh: 團隊提名保羅角逐客戶服務獎。

collocations.zh: 提名 A 擔任 B

example.en: The board nominated her as the next company president.
example.zh: 董事會提名她擔任下一任公司總裁。

example.en: Our design was nominated for an industry prize.
example.zh: 我們的設計被提名角逐業界獎項。

example.en: Each department must nominate one candidate by Friday.
example.zh: 每個部門必須在星期五前提名一位候選人。

examples.en: I would like to nominate Ms. Chen for the leadership award.
examples.zh: 我想提名陳小姐角逐領導獎。

examples.en: Employees may nominate a colleague for the Team Player Award.
examples.zh: 員工可以提名一位同事角逐最佳團隊合作獎。

examples.en: Staff are invited to nominate candidates before the end of May.
examples.zh: 歡迎員工在五月底前提名候選人。

confusable.diff: nominal 是形容詞，意思是「微小的、象徵性的」，和動詞 nominate 意思不同，只是長得像。
confusable.usage: nominal 是形容詞，常見於 nominal fee（象徵性費用）；nominate 是動詞，後面要接人。

example.en: We charge only a nominal fee for the training materials.
example.zh: 我們對訓練教材只收象徵性的費用。

similar.diff: appoint 是真的任命某人擔任職位，nominate 只是提名，還要經過決定。

example.en: The board appointed Mr. Kim as the new director.
example.zh: 董事會任命金先生擔任新的主管。

similar.diff: recommend 較口語，只是推薦；nominate 是正式程序，通常要填表或送審。

example.en: I recommend Ms. Lee for the sales manager position.
example.zh: 我推薦李小姐擔任業務經理一職。

example.en: The company will appoint a new manager next month.
example.zh: 公司下個月將任命一位新經理。

example.en: Can you recommend a good caterer for the event?
example.zh: 你能推薦活動用的好外燴業者嗎？

example.en: The final candidate will meet the whole team on Monday.
example.zh: 最後一位應徵者星期一會和整個團隊見面。

derived.link: nominate 去掉 -e 加 -ion 變名詞，像 create → creation

senses.en: to officially suggest someone for a prize or promotion
senses.distinguish: 後面接 for + 獎項或機會，表示推薦對方參加。

example.en: Managers can nominate staff for the yearly service award.
example.zh: 主管可以提名員工角逐年度服務獎。

senses.en: to choose someone to do a job or role
senses.distinguish: 後面接 to V 或 as + 職稱，表示指定去做某件事。

example.en: The committee nominated Mr. Kim to lead the meeting.
example.zh: 委員會指定金先生主持這場會議。

extra_vocab.en: the ability to think of new and interesting ideas
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 creativity 和 teamwork 並列，表示升遷審核除了業績，也會評估員工的創意與合作。屬於人資與徵才文章常見的能力用語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: creativity 是不可數名詞，不加 s，前面也不加 a。

example.en: Open offices can encourage creativity among team members.
example.zh: 開放式辦公室能鼓勵團隊成員發揮創意。

example.en: She showed great creativity when she solved the shipping problem.
example.zh: 她解決出貨問題時展現了很大的創意。

example.en: Creativity and innovation drive growth in our industry.
example.zh: 創意與創新推動我們產業的成長。

examples.en: Our design team is known for its creativity and attention to detail.
examples.zh: 我們的設計團隊以創意和注重細節聞名。

examples.en: This position requires creativity, strong writing skills, and teamwork.
examples.zh: 這個職位需要創意、優秀的寫作能力和團隊合作。

examples.en: The workshop helps employees develop their creativity at work.
examples.zh: 這場工作坊協助員工培養工作上的創造力。

confusable.diff: creativity 是「創造的能力」，creation 是「創造的行為」或「被創造出來的東西」。
confusable.usage: creativity 不可數；creation 當「作品」時可數，如 a new creation。

example.en: The creation of the new logo took three weeks.
example.zh: 製作新標誌花了三個星期。

similar.diff: innovation 指把新點子或新方法實際用出來的「創新」；creativity 是想出點子的能力。

example.en: Innovation helped the company enter a new market.
example.zh: 創新幫助公司進入了新市場。

similar.diff: imagination 是「想像力」，偏向腦中想像；creativity 更強調做出新東西。

example.en: The ad needs more imagination to attract young customers.
example.zh: 這則廣告需要更多想像力來吸引年輕顧客。

example.en: Innovation is the key to staying ahead of competitors.
example.zh: 創新是領先競爭對手的關鍵。

example.en: Good marketing needs imagination as well as data.
example.zh: 好的行銷除了數據也需要想像力。

example.en: We hire young talent from the best universities.
example.zh: 我們從最好的大學聘用年輕人才。

derived.link: creativity 的詞幹，create 是「創造」
create 去掉 -e 加 -ion，變名詞，像 relate → relation

extra_vocab.en: a situation in which people have different opinions
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 a disagreement about a final rating 指員工與評分結果之間的歧見，後面接申訴程序，是說明申訴流程的客氣、中性說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: disagreement 是可數名詞，要寫 a disagreement；意見不合的事情用 about 或 over，對象用 with。

example.en: Small disagreements are normal when a team works on a new project.
example.zh: 團隊進行新專案時，出現小意見不合是正常的。

example.en: The two departments met to resolve a disagreement over costs.
example.zh: 兩個部門開會解決費用上的歧見。

example.en: He had a disagreement with his supervisor about the deadline.
example.zh: 他和主管對截止日期意見不合。

example.en: There is a disagreement between the two reports.
example.zh: 這兩份報告之間有出入。

examples.en: The two managers had a disagreement about the budget.
examples.zh: 兩位經理對預算意見不合。

examples.en: Any disagreement about the schedule should be reported to Ms. Lee.
examples.zh: 對時程有任何歧見，應向李小姐報告。

examples.en: A disagreement over the price delayed the signing of the contract.
examples.zh: 價格上的歧見延後了合約的簽署。

confusable.diff: disagreeable 是形容詞，意思是「令人不愉快的」，不是「不同意」。
confusable.usage: disagreement 是名詞（意見不合）；disagreeable 形容人或事「討厭的」，不能用來說某人不同意。

example.en: The client was disagreeable and rejected every proposal we made.
example.zh: 那位客戶很難相處，否決了我們所有的提案。

similar.diff: dispute 的語氣較強，常指正式爭議，像價格或合約的糾紛。

example.en: The two companies are in a dispute over payment.
example.zh: 這兩家公司因為付款問題陷入爭議。

similar.diff: argument 是「爭論、爭吵」，語氣比 disagreement 更激烈，也可指「論點」。

example.en: The argument between the two teams lasted an hour.
example.zh: 兩個團隊之間的爭論持續了一個小時。

example.en: Her argument for a larger budget convinced the board.
example.zh: 她要求增加預算的論點說服了董事會。

example.en: The dispute with the supplier was solved last week.
example.zh: 和供應商的爭議上週已經解決。

example.en: A conflict of schedules forced us to cancel the meeting.
example.zh: 時間上的衝突迫使我們取消會議。

derived.link: disagreement 的詞幹，agree 是「同意」

senses.en: a situation in which people do not have the same opinion
senses.distinguish: 主詞是人，後面接 about、over 說明歧見的內容。

example.en: We had a short disagreement about who should lead the project.
example.zh: 我們對誰該帶領專案有過一小段歧見。

senses.en: a difference between two sets of facts or numbers
senses.distinguish: 主詞是報告或數字，表示兩邊不一致。

example.en: Our audit found a disagreement between the invoice and the order.
example.zh: 我們的稽核發現發票與訂單之間有出入。

extra_vocab.en: a meeting or place where people talk about a topic
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 open forum 指任何人都可以參加、提問的公開說明會，用來讓員工發問。open forum 是公司公告很常見的說法。

example.en: Our website has two forums for customers and for dealers.
example.zh: 我們的網站有兩個論壇，分別給顧客和經銷商。

example.en: The meeting ended with an open forum for staff questions.
example.zh: 會議最後以讓員工發問的公開討論會作結。

example.en: We plan to hold a forum on workplace safety in June.
example.zh: 我們計畫在六月舉辦一場職場安全討論會。

example.en: I found the answer on an online forum for engineers.
example.zh: 我在一個工程師的網路論壇上找到了答案。

example.en: The mayor spoke at a public forum about the new bridge.
example.zh: 市長在一場公開論壇上談論新橋。

examples.en: The company will hold a forum for all new employees.
examples.zh: 公司將為所有新進員工舉辦一場討論會。

examples.en: Many customers ask questions on the product's online forum.
examples.zh: 許多顧客在產品的網路論壇上發問。

examples.en: The city is hosting a forum on public transportation next week.
examples.zh: 市政府下週將舉辦一場大眾運輸討論會。

confusable.diff: form 是「表格」或「形式」，forum 是「討論會、論壇」，字形相近但意思不同。

example.en: The form must be signed and returned by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 這份表格必須在星期五下午前簽名並交回。

similar.diff: town hall meeting 常指公司或社區的全體說明會，由主管回答大家問題；forum 範圍更廣。

example.en: The CEO answered questions at the town hall meeting.
example.zh: 執行長在全體說明會上回答問題。

similar.diff: panel discussion 是由幾位專家上台討論，聽眾以聽為主；forum 更強調公開交流。

example.en: Three experts joined the panel discussion on remote work.
example.zh: 三位專家參加了關於遠距工作的座談。

example.en: I attended a seminar on customer service last week.
example.zh: 我上週參加了一場客戶服務研討會。

example.en: The workshop teaches new staff how to use the system.
example.zh: 這場工作坊教新進員工如何使用系統。

example.en: She will present her findings at the conference in May.
example.zh: 她將在五月的會議上報告她的研究結果。

senses.en: a meeting where people can talk about a topic
senses.distinguish: 指現場舉辦的活動，常和 hold、host 一起用。

example.en: The forum gave employees a chance to ask about the new policy.
example.zh: 這場討論會讓員工有機會詢問新政策。

senses.en: a website where people post questions and answers
senses.distinguish: 指網站，常有 online、user 等字出現。

example.en: Users share tips on the support forum every day.
example.zh: 使用者每天在支援論壇上分享技巧。
